domain_payload.title: Synthetic forecasting repetition study
domain_payload.statement: Do lag-feature ridge forecasts stay above a seasonal-naive baseline across seeds under a gapped time-series split?

data_spec.source: synthetic generator, two seasonalities plus noise

domain_payload.holdout_policy: All partitions are synthetic. The test partition is evaluated once at the end; the future holdout is never touched by tuning or selection.
completion_criteria: Gap and embargo declarations are present in the split section.
Seed repetition study reports mean and variance, never best-only.
